If things don’t quite go to plan with your order, you’ve got a few options:

Cancel quickly: You have about 15 minutes after the order confirmation to cancel via the email or your Chilly’s account.
Return it: You can return unused products within 30 days of delivery (not engraved items). UK returns go through the online portal; overseas returns are posted to our returns address.
Faulty or damaged? Don’t send it back straight away—hold onto the item and contact our Customer Service Team so we can help. All products are under warranty for 2 years against manufacturing defects.
Gift cards: If you need to cancel a gift card, our usual 15‑minute window doesn’t apply, but Customer Service can void the card for you.
Order not arrived? After the stated waiting times for your region, check tracking, neighbors, and safe places; if it’s still missing, reach out to Customer Service so we can investigate.
Payment problems? If your payment isn’t working, you can try different methods (cards, wallets, Klarna, local options). If issues persist, contact Customer Service with screenshots and device/browser details.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.

How do I use it correctly to get the best result?

Sent · Just now

Chilly's Agent · AI

Chilly's Agent · AI says:

To get the best result from your Chilly’s gear, treat it like a little insulated helper you look after and it looks after you:

Before first use: Wash with hot soapy water, rinse and air-dry.
Filling:
Don’t use liquids over 90°C/194°F.
Avoid shaking or inverting bottles/cups with hot liquids inside.
Most products are great for hot or cold drinks, but Flip Lids and Original Sports Lids are not for hot or fizzy drinks.
Don’t leave organic drinks like milk or orange juice in overnight to avoid pressure build-up and damage.
Temperature tips:
For cold drinks, pre-chill with fridge-cold water and/or add ice (Big Mouth and most bottles love ice).
For hot drinks in Coffee Cups, pre-heat with hot water, empty, then add your drink so it stays hot longer.
Leak-proof vs spill-proof:
Series 2 & 3 Bottles and Series 3 Flip are leak-proof when assembled correctly.
Series 2 Coffee Cups, Original Sports Lids, and Series 2 Flip Lids are not fully leak-proof – always carry upright.
Assembly checks:
Series 2/3 Bottles: make sure the collar is attached tightly before filling and don’t over-tighten the lid.
Series 2 Coffee Cup: fit the retainer and twist it in with a coin until it clicks.
Series 2 Flip / Switch / Flip Lids: ensure the straw is properly attached and never drink by tipping the bottle above your mouth (use it like a straw).
Cleaning & care:
Hand wash only: bottles, Coffee Cups, Flip, Series 2 Switch, Series 3, Big Mouth. Use hot soapy water; for deep cleans use a paste of bicarbonate soda/baking powder + water + dish soap and leave for about 60 minutes, then scrub.
Do not put most products in the dishwasher, microwave, freezer, or leave them to soak.
Store with the cap off when not in use so the inside can dry and stay fresh.
Special notes:
Big Mouth handles water, hot coffee, fizzy drinks, and alcohol, but not organic juices/milk.
Series 2 Switch: use cup mode for hot drinks; straw mode only for cold.
Original Sports Lid: only for Original Bottles, and not for hot or fizzy drinks.

Follow those pointers and you’ll get maximum temperature performance, minimum leaks, and a bottle or cup that stays fresh and lasts for years.
